notes.text: Available in cPanel 54 and later; uses the selected account context. No request defaults are declared in the pinned operation.

Returns display information for the server available and configured identity-provider modules. Provider documentation and configuration URLs and icon bytes are returned payload data; the client neither follows URLs nor decodes or renders icons. Empty lists and omitted record fields remain distinct.
Available in cPanel 54 and later; uses the selected account context. No request defaults are declared in the pinned operation.

Returns identity-provider links for the current cPanel account. link_time is an optional integer Unix timestamp. The source declares subject_unique_identifier as an optional integer in this response, while removeAuthnLink requires a string input; no shared identifier format or lossless round trip is inferred. Omitted fields remain absent.
Available in cPanel 66 and later; uses the selected account context. No request defaults are declared in the pinned operation.

The data payload is an integer 0/1 flag: 1 means the user enabled an external module and 0 means none is enabled. Payload zero is a successful result when the UAPI envelope status is 1; UAPI status=0 remains an API failure.
Available in cPanel 54 and later; uses the selected account context. No request defaults are declared in the pinned operation.

Unlinks the specified external identity-provider account from the selected cPanel account. provider and subjectUniqueIdentifier are required strings; identifiers are forwarded unchanged without numeric conversion, truncation or assumptions about provider-specific formats.

This mutation uses form POST. The source declares no rollback; the client performs no automatic retry or rollback. The result is a nullable object without pinned fields: preserve opaque object fields and explicit null, and reject an absent data member.
